functions.plate_comment: Builds 12-element used array from nonzero primary entries and their nonzero backup bytes, via unlocked GetSharedUserMapInfo pointer. Returns first unused primary 2..5 (want_backup=0) or backup 6..9 (nonzero), otherwise -1. GetBakMapFlagStartPos=6 in librobopersist. No locking/reservation here; no checks before using loaded flag bytes as array indexes. Flags 10/11 are not allocator candidates.
Counts nonzero primary bytes from unlocked catalog pointer. Capacity limit is four only when mode==1, otherwise one; returns count below limit. This is not slot reservation.

Copies each 0x24-byte entry from live unlocked catalog while scanning primary. If matching entry has nonzero backup byte, uses GetOldestMapFlagIndex (constant 0 in this build) to return that backup; otherwise tail-calls rr_get_unused_persist_map_flag(true). Imported helper receives start-of-array pointer, not selected copy; with constant index 0 this does not alter selection. No file-existence or validity check; environment/path buffer setup does not choose a file here.
Returns 1 only for matching nonzero primary byte among four entries; reads unlocked catalog pointer and does not check any map file.

Returns matching entry+4 name-byte pointer or static fallback pointer; four entries, stride 0x24. Pointer is not locked and 32 stored name bytes need not be NUL-terminated; no validation/termination added here.
Returns zero-extended primary byte for first matching backup byte, else -1. No nonzero-primary/backup check; reads unlocked pointer; passing zero can match an empty entry.
